title: Launch party for Hi, Hi, Hi/C Moon by Wings | 1972
content:
A launch party was held for Wings’ single ‘Hi, Hi, Hi’/‘C Moon’ on 30 November 1972.

The invitation-only party took place at Global Village, a leisure complex near London’s Charing Cross Station, from midday to 2pm.

Members of the press attended, and one-on-one interviews were arranged between the leading music publications and the members of Wings.
